vulnerability_cn: 价格初始化前可建立流动性头寸，初始化后结算出真实资产
vulnerability_en: Liquidity positions accepted before price initialization can settle into real assets afterward
detail_cn: 已取得攻击时执行的链上 Sierra 类并校验类哈希，保存完整反编译及攻击相关函数切片。mint 的池检查只要求 PoolParams.fee 非零，价格仍为零时也能建立头寸；initialize_pool_price 随后允许写入初始价格，burn、collect 把头寸变为真实资产应收。原始 RPC 跟踪核对了 12 轮真实资产存入均为 0，随后实际转出 ETH、STRK、USDC.e、USDT。反编译保留原始指令编号，不是已验证的原始 Cairo 源码；305000 美元沿用源表估值。
detail_en: The historically executed on-chain Sierra class was recovered and its class hash verified. Complete decompilation and a dependency-closed attack slice are included. The mint pool check only requires a nonzero PoolParams.fee, allowing positions while the price is still zero. initialize_pool_price then sets the initial price, after which burn and collect produce real-asset claims. Raw RPC traces verify zero real-asset deposits and actual ETH, STRK, USDC.e and USDT transfers across all 12 rounds. Original instruction IDs are retained; this is decompiled code, not verified original Cairo source. USD 305000 preserves the sheet estimate.
